msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible, and what would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Since your last dive was three years ago, you’ll need a refresher. The refresher ends around noon, and certified divers should wait at least 18 hours after their last dive before flying. A Friday 10 a.m. flight would be too soon, so Thursday’s dive wouldn’t fit safely with your flight.

The refresher from Cartagena is booked as the Dive Mini Course. I’m leaving the price below. You can book online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

The website closes bookings for the next day at 4:30 p.m. the day before.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like help considering another date that gives you enough time before flying?

msg: OK, then I'd rather dive on Wednesday. Is the refresher all I do that day, or can I also do normal dives? And how do I book?
reply:
The refresher is the activity for the day: it includes pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor, plus lunch. Since you’ve been out of the water for three years, a refresher is normally required before returning to regular dives.

You can book it online as the *Dive Mini Course* here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. The day runs from 8:00 a.m. at Muelle de la Bodeguita, with an estimated return to Cartagena at 4:15 p.m. Please note that the refresher requires an **18-hour wait before flying**; Wednesday’s dive would be too close to your Friday 10:00 a.m. flight.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: Wait, Wednesday morning to Friday at 10 is almost two days, isn't that enough? Just one person, me.
reply:
You’re right—Wednesday morning to Friday at 10 a.m. is more than 18 hours. The refresher dive ends around noon on Wednesday, so you’d have about 46 hours before your flight. That meets the 18-hour minimum.

✅ *Refresher added* — it is the mini-course: pool training and one dive with an instructor, on its own day. It costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
